head: 7 minute workout app FitIn7: one $0.99 purchase, no subscription
dek: FitIn7 is a new iPhone and iPad app for a 7-minute bodyweight workout at home, sold for $0.99 once with no subscription, ads or account. It came out on 21 November and was #25 among paid Health & Fitness apps on the US App Store on 22 November.
details: The workout has 12 exercises of 30 seconds each and needs no equipment. The app shows animated form guides, gives voice and haptic cues, and lets you change the rest time and the number of circuits. It works offline and can log workouts to Apple Health if you allow it. The maker, Ashay Suresh Manjure, says it doesn't track you, and the listing notes it isn't medical advice.
where: iPhone and iPad, iOS 17 or later, App Store
means: If you want a short home workout without another monthly fee, this one costs 99 cents once and starts in one tap.
todo: Look at the App Store listing first; it's version 1.0 and has no ratings yet.
